name: Forexery
tagline: A reinforcement-learning agent that trades USD/JPY using news sentiment plus technical signals.

awards: Best Predictive Intelligence by Chestnut Forty

problem: Most retail forex traders lose money; technical indicators miss why markets move.
solution: Trains an RL agent in a trading environment combining sentiment from news with technical features.
demo_moment: Team-described: compare the agent's returns against buy-and-hold.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Predictive Intelligence by Chestnut Forty” among 195 submissions.
Combines why (news) and what (price) in one model.

lessons: Show training curves and a baseline when claiming trading results.
